pages:
{rival} has been running his mouth
about {player} all week long.

Tonight {player} gets the chance
to shut him up. One on one.
grudge.requirement:
Singles match: {player} vs {rival}.
Win, and a title shot is yours.

pages:
{player} pinned {rival}!
The whole arena is on its feet.

{boss} was watching from the back.
He's next.

{rival} stands tall over {player}.
This isn't over.

The boss grants a rematch.
One more chance.

{player} wants {rival} again.
No excuses this time.
rematch.requirement:
Singles match: {player} vs {rival}.
Lose, and the story is over.

pages:
{rival} wins again.
{player} walks to the back alone.

{boss} says {player} got lucky.
Time to prove him wrong.
title.requirement:
Main event: {player} vs {boss}.
Win it all.

pages:
From grudge to glory.
THE END
